<style id="psg-site">
/* ProSiteGuide site-wide: archive headings/cards + static page components */
:root{--psg-navy:#0F172A;--psg-blue:#1D4ED8;--psg-slate:#475569;--psg-line:#E2E8F0;--psg-soft:#F8FAFC;--psg-blue-50:#EFF6FF}
/* archives */
.archive .page-title,.blog .page-title{font-size:0!important;line-height:0}
.archive .page-title span{display:block;font-size:clamp(2.1rem,1.6rem + 2vw,3.2rem);line-height:1.1}
.archive .page-header{margin-bottom:28px}
.post-grid .card__title{font-size:1.3rem!important;line-height:1.3!important;margin:.35em 0 .5em}
.post-grid .card__title a{color:var(--psg-navy)!important;text-decoration:none}
.post-grid .card__title a:hover{color:var(--psg-blue)!important}
.post-grid .card__image img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
/* static pages */
.psg-page{font-size:18px;line-height:1.75;color:#1E293B}
.psg-page h2{margin:2.2em 0 .6em;font-size:clamp(1.45rem,1.2rem + .9vw,1.85rem);line-height:1.25;color:var(--psg-navy)}
.psg-page h3{margin:1.6em 0 .4em;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--psg-navy)}
.psg-page a{color:var(--psg-blue);text-underline-offset:3px}
.psg-page .psg-lead{font-size:1.2rem;line-height:1.65;color:#334155;margin-bottom:1.6em}
.psg-page .psg-updated{font-size:14px;color:var(--psg-slate);margin-bottom:2em}
.psg-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fit,minmax(240px,1fr));gap:18px;margin:1.6em 0 2em}
.psg-tile{display:block;border:1px solid var(--psg-line);border-radius:14px;padding:20px;background:#fff;text-decoration:none!important;color:#334155!important;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04),0 8px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.05);transition:border-color .15s,transform .15s}
a.psg-tile:hover{border-color:#93C5FD;transform:translateY(-2px)}
.psg-tile .psg-kicker{display:block;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--psg-blue);margin-bottom:6px}
.psg-tile strong{display:block;font-size:1.08rem;line-height:1.35;color:var(--psg-navy);margin-bottom:6px}
.psg-tile span.psg-desc{display:block;font-size:15px;line-height:1.55}
.psg-steps{counter-reset:step;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:1.4em 0 2em}
.psg-steps li{counter-increment:step;position:relative;padding:0 0 18px 58px;margin:0}
.psg-steps li::before{content:counter(step);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:40px;height:40px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--psg-blue-50);color:var(--psg-blue);font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:16px}
.psg-steps li strong{display:block;color:var(--psg-navy)}
.psg-band{background:var(--psg-navy);color:#CBD5E1;border-radius:18px;padding:30px 30px 28px;margin:2.4em 0}
.psg-band h2,.psg-band h3{color:#fff!important;margin:0 0 .4em!important}
.psg-band p{margin:0 0 1.1em}
.psg-band a.psg-btn,.psg-page a.psg-btn{display:inline-block;background:var(--psg-blue);color:#fff!important;text-decoration:none!important;font-weight:600;padding:12px 20px;border-radius:10px;font-size:16px}
.psg-band a.psg-btn:hover{background:#1E40AF}
.psg-checks{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:1em 0 1.6em}
.psg-checks li{position:relative;padding-left:30px;margin-bottom:.55em}
.psg-checks li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:4px;top:.55em;width:12px;height:7px;border-left:2.5px solid #16A34A;border-bottom:2.5px solid #16A34A;transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.psg-glossary dt{font-weight:700;color:var(--psg-navy);margin-top:1.3em;scroll-margin-top:96px}
.psg-glossary dd{margin:.25em 0 0;padding-bottom:1.1em;border-bottom:1px solid var(--psg-line)}
.psg-az{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px;margin:1em 0 1.6em}
.psg-az a{display:inline-block;min-width:34px;text-align:center;padding:6px 8px;border:1px solid var(--psg-line);border-radius:8px;text-decoration:none;font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:var(--psg-navy)}
.psg-az a:hover{border-color:var(--psg-blue);color:var(--psg-blue)}
.psg-note{background:var(--psg-blue-50);border:1px solid #BFDBFE;border-radius:12px;padding:16px 18px;font-size:16px;margin:1.6em 0}
@media (max-width:700px){.psg-page{font-size:17px}.psg-band{padding:24px 20px}}

/* ===== v2: designed pages (full width) ===== */
body.page:has(.psg-x){overflow-x:clip}
.page article.entry:has(.psg-x){max-width:none!important;width:100%!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important}
.page article.entry:has(.psg-x) > .entry-header{display:none}
.page article.entry:has(.psg-x) .entry-content,.psg-x{max-width:none!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important}
.page #primary:has(.psg-x),.page .site-main:has(.psg-x){padding-top:0!important;padding-bottom:0!important}
.psg-x{font-size:17px;line-height:1.7;color:#334155}
.psg-x p{margin:0 0 1em}
.psg-x a{color:var(--psg-blue)}
.psg-wrap{max-width:1180px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.psg-narrow{max-width:780px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px}
.psg-sec{padding:84px 0}
.psg-sec--soft{background:var(--psg-soft);border-top:1px solid var(--psg-line);border-bottom:1px solid var(--psg-line)}
.psg-sec--tight{padding:56px 0}
.psg-eyebrow{display:inline-block;font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--psg-blue);margin-bottom:12px}
.psg-x h1{font-size:clamp(2.3rem,1.6rem + 2.6vw,3.6rem);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.025em;color:var(--psg-navy);margin:0 0 18px}
.psg-x h2{font-size:clamp(1.7rem,1.3rem + 1.3vw,2.4rem);line-height:1.15;letter-spacing:-.02em;color:var(--psg-navy);margin:0 0 14px}
.psg-x h3{font-size:1.15rem;line-height:1.35;color:var(--psg-navy);margin:0 0 8px}
.psg-sec-head{max-width:720px;margin-bottom:40px}
.psg-sec-head.center{margin-left:auto;margin-right:auto;text-align:center}
.psg-sec-head p{font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--psg-slate)}
/* hero */
.psg-hero{position:relative;padding:88px 0 76px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#F8FAFF 0%,#FFFFFF 100%);border-bottom:1px solid var(--psg-line);overflow:hidden}
.psg-hero::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:radial-gradient(#CBD5E1 1px,transparent 1px);background-size:22px 22px;opacity:.45;-webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 0%,transparent 85%);mask-image:linear-gradient(180deg,#000 0%,transparent 85%)}
.psg-hero::after{content:"";position:absolute;width:520px;height:520px;right:-140px;top:-180px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(37,99,235,.16),transparent 65%)}
.psg-hero .psg-wrap{position:relative;z-index:1}
.psg-hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr .9fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.psg-hero .psg-lead{font-size:1.22rem;line-height:1.6;color:#475569;max-width:640px;margin-bottom:28px}
.psg-hero--simple .psg-lead{margin-bottom:8px}
.psg-btns{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px}
.psg-x a.psg-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;background:var(--psg-blue);color:#fff!important;text-decoration:none!important;font-weight:600;padding:13px 22px;border-radius:12px;font-size:16px;box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(29,78,216,.22);transition:background .15s,transform .15s}
.psg-x a.psg-btn:hover{background:#1E40AF;transform:translateY(-1px)}
.psg-x a.psg-btn--ghost{background:#fff;color:var(--psg-navy)!important;border:1px solid #CBD5E1;box-shadow:none}
.psg-x a.psg-btn--ghost:hover{background:#fff;border-color:var(--psg-blue);color:var(--psg-blue)!important}
.psg-x a.psg-btn--light{background:#fff;color:var(--psg-navy)!important;box-shadow:none}
.psg-x a.psg-btn--light:hover{background:#DBEAFE}
.psg-panel{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--psg-line);border-radius:20px;padding:26px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04),0 18px 40px rgba(15,23,42,.08)}
.psg-panel h3{font-size:1.05rem}
.psg-mini{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.psg-mini li{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:12px 0;border-top:1px solid var(--psg-line);font-size:15px;line-height:1.5}
.psg-mini li:first-child{border-top:0;padding-top:4px}
.psg-mini li strong{display:block;color:var(--psg-navy)}
.psg-ico{flex:none;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--psg-blue-50);color:var(--psg-blue);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.psg-ico svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.psg-mini .psg-ico{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px}
.psg-mini .psg-ico svg{width:18px;height:18px}
/* feature cards */
.psg-cards{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.psg-cards.c2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.psg-cards.c4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.psg-card2{position:relative;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--psg-line);border-radius:18px;padding:26px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04),0 10px 26px rgba(15,23,42,.05);text-decoration:none!important;color:#334155!important;transition:border-color .15s,transform .15s,box-shadow .15s}
a.psg-card2:hover{border-color:#93C5FD;transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04),0 16px 34px rgba(15,23,42,.09)}
.psg-card2 p{margin:0;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.6}
.psg-card2 ul{margin:4px 0 0;padding:0;list-style:none;font-size:14.5px}
.psg-card2 ul li{position:relative;padding-left:22px;margin:6px 0}
.psg-card2 ul li::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:3px;top:.55em;width:9px;height:5px;border-left:2px solid #16A34A;border-bottom:2px solid #16A34A;transform:rotate(-45deg)}
.psg-more{margin-top:auto;padding-top:6px;font-weight:600;font-size:15px;color:var(--psg-blue)}
.psg-tagline{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--psg-slate)}
/* split */
.psg-split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.psg-split.top{align-items:start}
/* numbered steps (horizontal) */
.psg-flow{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:16px;counter-reset:f}
.psg-flow.f4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.psg-flow > div{counter-increment:f;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--psg-line);border-radius:16px;padding:22px 20px;position:relative}
.psg-flow > div::before{content:counter(f,decimal-leading-zero);display:block;font:700 13px/1 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--psg-blue);margin-bottom:12px}
.psg-flow h3{font-size:1.02rem}
.psg-flow p{font-size:14.5px;margin:0;line-height:1.55}
/* path (vertical) */
.psg-path{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;counter-reset:pa;position:relative}
.psg-path::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:21px;top:10px;bottom:10px;width:2px;background:linear-gradient(#BFDBFE,#E2E8F0)}
.psg-path li{counter-increment:pa;position:relative;padding:0 0 26px 68px}
.psg-path li::before{content:counter(pa);position:absolute;left:0;top:0;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:2px solid var(--psg-blue);color:var(--psg-blue);font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.psg-path h3{margin:8px 0 4px}
.psg-path p{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:15.5px}
/* chips */
.psg-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px}
.psg-chips span{display:inline-block;padding:8px 14px;border:1px solid var(--psg-line);border-radius:999px;background:#fff;font-size:14px;font-weight:600;color:var(--psg-navy)}
/* FAQ */
.psg-faq{display:grid;gap:12px}
.psg-faq details{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--psg-line);border-radius:14px;padding:0 22px}
.psg-faq summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:18px 0;font-weight:600;color:var(--psg-navy);font-size:16.5px}
.psg-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.psg-faq summary::after{content:"+";flex:none;width:28px;height:28px;border-radius:8px;background:var(--psg-blue-50);color:var(--psg-blue);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:18px;font-weight:600}
.psg-faq details[open] summary::after{content:"\2212"}
.psg-faq details > div{padding:0 0 18px;font-size:15.5px}
/* CTA band */
.psg-ctaband{background:radial-gradient(circle at 85% 0%,rgba(59,130,246,.35),transparent 45%),var(--psg-navy);color:#CBD5E1;border-radius:24px;padding:52px 48px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr auto;gap:28px;align-items:center}
.psg-ctaband h2{color:#fff;margin-bottom:8px}
.psg-ctaband p{margin:0;font-size:1.08rem}
/* prose card (legal etc.) */
.psg-prose{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--psg-line);border-radius:20px;padding:44px 48px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04),0 10px 26px rgba(15,23,42,.05)}
.psg-prose h2{font-size:1.4rem;margin:1.8em 0 .5em}
.psg-prose h2:first-child{margin-top:0}
.psg-prose h3{margin-top:1.3em}
.psg-prose ul{padding-left:20px}
.psg-prose li{margin-bottom:.45em}
.psg-toc2{position:sticky;top:100px;font-size:14.5px}
.psg-toc2 p{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--psg-slate);margin-bottom:10px}
.psg-toc2 a{display:block;padding:6px 0 6px 12px;border-left:2px solid var(--psg-line);color:var(--psg-slate);text-decoration:none}
.psg-toc2 a:hover{color:var(--psg-blue);border-left-color:var(--psg-blue)}
.psg-legal{display:grid;grid-template-columns:220px 1fr;gap:48px;align-items:start}
/* glossary v2 */
.psg-gl{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:16px}
.psg-gl div{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--psg-line);border-radius:14px;padding:20px 22px;scroll-margin-top:100px}
.psg-gl dt{font-weight:700;color:var(--psg-navy);font-size:16.5px;margin-bottom:6px}
.psg-gl dd{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.6}
.psg-letter{grid-column:1/-1;font:700 1.4rem 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;color:var(--psg-blue);margin:18px 0 0;scroll-margin-top:100px}
/* contact */
.psg-contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.35fr .9fr;gap:40px;align-items:start}
.psg-formcard{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--psg-line);border-radius:20px;padding:34px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(15,23,42,.04),0 18px 40px rgba(15,23,42,.08)}
.psg-formcard .elementor-field-group{margin-bottom:4px}
.psg-formcard label{font-weight:600;font-size:14px;color:var(--psg-navy)}
.psg-formcard .elementor-field-type-acceptance label{font-weight:400;color:#475569}
.psg-side{display:grid;gap:16px}
@media (max-width:1024px){.psg-hero-grid,.psg-split,.psg-contact,.psg-legal{grid-template-columns:1fr}.psg-cards,.psg-cards.c4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.psg-flow,.psg-flow.f4{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.psg-toc2{display:none}.psg-ctaband{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media (max-width:680px){.psg-sec{padding:60px 0}.psg-hero{padding:56px 0 52px}.psg-cards,.psg-cards.c2,.psg-cards.c4,.psg-flow,.psg-flow.f4,.psg-gl{grid-template-columns:1fr}.psg-ctaband{padding:36px 24px}.psg-prose{padding:28px 22px}.psg-formcard{padding:22px}}
.psg-me{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;margin:4px 0 18px}
.psg-me img{width:96px;height:96px;border-radius:50%;object-fit:cover;object-position:top;border:3px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 6px 18px rgba(15,23,42,.15)}
.psg-me strong{display:block;color:var(--psg-navy);font-size:1.1rem}.psg-me span{display:block;font-size:15px;color:var(--psg-slate)}
.psg-me--lg{justify-content:center;text-align:left;max-width:620px;margin:0 auto 26px}.psg-me--lg img{width:120px;height:120px}
.psg-stats{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:16px;max-width:980px;margin:0 auto}
.psg-stats div{background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--psg-line);border-radius:16px;padding:20px;text-align:center}
.psg-stats b{display:block;font:700 2rem 'Space Grotesk',sans-serif;color:var(--psg-blue);line-height:1.1}.psg-stats span{display:block;font-size:14px;color:var(--psg-slate);margin-top:6px}
.psg-shot{padding:0 0 22px;overflow:hidden}.psg-shot img{width:100%;height:auto;display:block;border-bottom:1px solid var(--psg-line)}
.psg-shot h3,.psg-shot p,.psg-shot .psg-more{padding:0 22px}.psg-shot h3{margin-top:4px}
.psg-portfolio{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.psg-quote{margin:0}.psg-quote blockquote{margin:0;font-size:1.15rem;line-height:1.5;color:var(--psg-navy);font-weight:600}.psg-quote figcaption{font-size:14px;color:var(--psg-slate)}
@media (max-width:1024px){.psg-portfolio,.psg-stats{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media (max-width:680px){.psg-portfolio,.psg-stats{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
